Name: The Jnomes - Joja Projects
Author: Sable17
Description:
[quote][size=5]We came here in search of progress opportunities.
And we brought some old [color=#3d85c6][b]Joja [/b][/color]development plans with us![/size][/quote]
A few days after purchasing a [b][color=#3d85c6]Joja Membership[/color][/b]... [b]you'll get a short cutscene one night[/b]. 

Then you just might find...

[b][color=#3d85c6][size=4]The Jnomes![/size][/color][/b]
Five cute little guys who love [color=#3d85c6][b]Joja [/b][/color]and love progress!
They brought with them some Project plans from JojaCo!
Help them [b][color=#ffd966]fund [/color][/b]these projects and bring more [color=#3d85c6][b]Joja [/b][/color]to [b]Pelican Town[/b]!

[color=#3d85c6][size=4][b]The [/b][/size][/color][color=#3d85c6][size=4][b]Projects[/b][/size][/color] [color=#efefef]-[/color][color=#f4f4f4] Five projects to build small additions to Pelican Town! [/color]

• [b][color=#3d85c6]Vending Machines[/color][/b]
     Install Joja Cola [b]vending machines[/b] around town!
• [b][color=#3d85c6]Joja Shipping Bin[/color][/b]
     Rebrand your [b]shipping bin[/b], increasing the value of shipped goods by 5%!
•[color=#3d85c6] [b]Joja Garden Center[/b][/color]
      Build a [b]Joja Garden Center[/b], selling Joja branded seeds!
• [b][color=#3d85c6]Joja Cafe[/color][/b]
      Build a [b]Joja Cafe [/b]serving a daily special with an all-day buff!
• [b][color=#3d85c6]Joja Mini Mart[/color][/b]
      Build a [b]JojaMiniMart [/b]that's open 24 hours!
[b]NOTE[/b]: If some other event triggers during the night, the Jnomes will do their construction the following night! 

Some NPCs will have [b]dialogue [/b]about the completed projects! (Poor Pierre...)
[b]Optional [/b]GMCM setting to have a couple NPCs visit the Garden Center/Cafe/MiniMart. Disabled by default!
[spoiler]NPCs that visit the new establishments: Sam, Jodi, Haley, Pierre, Shane, Caroline, Evelyn. [/spoiler]

[size=4]Help the [color=#3d85c6][b]Jnomes [/b][/color]give Pelican Town a little more [b][color=#3d85c6]Joja[/color][/b]-branded love![/size]

[b]Compatible with and has custom map edits for [color=#ffffff][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url][/color]! SVE is highly recommended![/b]

[b]**HEAVY [color=#cc0000]SPOILERS [/color]FOR THE STARDEW VALLEY EXPANDED JOJA ROUTE BELOW**[/b]
[spoiler]With Stardew Valley Expanded installed: After seeing Morris' 10 Heart Event Part 4, roads will be added linking the MiniMart and the Cafe to the roads installed by Mayor Morris!
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52568/52568-1789954436-1876334098.png[/img]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52568/52568-1789954443-1173136116.png[/img]
*Since the screenshots, the pathway to the cafe shifted over a tile to fix the dark grass cutoff. I didn't want to take another picture. Sorry! :([/spoiler]

[b]Requirements[/b]
• Stardew Valley 1.6+
• SMAPI
• Content Patcher
• SpaceCore
• BETAS

[b]Incompatible with:[/b]
Other mods that occupy the same spaces the projects are placed. There will be clipping/overwriting. Sorry!
